comment: The DSP is the Parasite alternative firmware for Warps, vendored at alt_firmware/parasites; src/distortiones.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one modulator per polyphonic channel. It adds eight modes to the original cross-modulation set, which survives here as Meta mode, and replaces the F.S button with MD, a mode selector that takes over the big knob. The level jacks carry two normals each in effect: distortiones.cpp:185 reads the first with getNormalVoltage(5) for the gain and distortiones.cpp:210 reads the same jack again with getNormalVoltage(2) for the internal oscillator's pitch. The algorithm control voltage is applied only while the mode selector is off, at distortiones.cpp:199. Per-channel reads use getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so a monophonic cable patched to a control voltage jack drives the first channel alone; the MODE jack is the exception and is read four channels at a time.
